description: This file defines the OpenIDConnectClient class which extends the OpenIDConnectClient from an external library and implements specific authentication session management methods for the OrangeHRM system's OpenID authentication plugin.

classes.name: OpenIDConnectClient
classes.description: Extension of the external OpenIDConnectClient class adding custom session handling for OrangeHRM's OpenID plugin.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Sets the generated authentication URL for redirecting user to external identity provider.

methods.name: commitSession
methods.description: Placeholder method for session commitment, implementation is empty.

methods.name: setSessionKey
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in the authenticated user attributes.

methods.name: getSessionKey
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a given key from the authenticated user attributes.

methods.name: unsetSessionKey
methods.description: Removes a specified attribute from the authenticated user.
